standout_why: I couldn't open any page this run, so this score is a judgement and not a comparison I checked. The cited rival pages (Lumary's own 9W, RGBAI Pro and directional gimbal pages, Best Buy L-GL4B4, and the Wayfair 6-inch LMAF1001) returned HTTP 429, timed out or showed a bot wall. ChatGPT's answer already gives raw lumens per fixture and price per 4-pack. That means a derived figure like lumens per watt or $ per fixture would only partly add to what shoppers already see. It would decide the pick only if it reordered the candidates, and I couldn't check that.
decides: No change to the pick from this run. Once the inputs can be sourced, the figure most likely to change the order is $ per 100 lm per fixture (4-pack price ÷ 4 ÷ lumens × 100). It would show whether the CloudyBay 6-inch beats the Lumary 4-inch models on value (our page has it at $109.99, 850 lm, 3-year warranty, seen 2026-11-14), and whether the 90° Ultra and Pro cost more per lumen than the 40° 9W.
